Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Main responsibilities

  • Atuar em demandas jurídicas ambientais, incluindo licenciamento, regularização de ativos, contratos, pareceres e contencioso judicial e administrativo;
  • Interpretar e aplicar normas ambientais, acompanhando atualizações legais e regulatórias;
  • Representar a empresa em tratativas com órgãos ambientais, Ministério Público e demais entidades, oferecendo suporte técnico-jurídico;
  • Conduzir e acompanhar processos administrativos, autos de infração e TACs, garantindo conformidade e prazos;
  • Prestar consultoria interna às áreas da empresa, avaliando riscos socioambientais e propondo soluções jurídicas;
  • Gerenciar carteira de processos ambientais e subsidiar escritórios terceirizados na elaboração de defesas e estratégias;
  • Atuar em demandas vinculadas à parceria com o INEA, elaborando pareceres e orientações jurídicas.

Sitting within the Ticketing Department, Ticketing aims to deliver the most engaging, innovative, and accessible Women’s World Cup experience for all athletes, fans, partners, and the community. Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing, the Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will help serve Ticketing sales, operations and efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil™ 2027 that for the first time ever, will be hosted in South America. The Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive ticket sales strategies to ensure optimal attendance and revenue generation for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 in Brazil. The role requires a strong understanding of the Brazilian sports market, exceptional stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to drive innovative ticketing initiatives not only across all 8 host cities but in the wider region.

  • Develop and execute ticket sales strategies to maximize revenue and stadium occupancy across all venues.

  • Collaborate with marketing and communications teams to build and ensure the alignment of ticketing and hospitality promotions with overall event campaigns and timelines.
  • Build and manage relationships with domestic stakeholders incl., venue operators, host cities and key stakeholders to optimize ticketing and hospitality opportunities.
  • Monitor ticket sales performance, analyze data, and provide regular reports with insights and recommendations for improvement, with a particular focus on strategies to increase sales, attendance, and overall revenue.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA ticketing standards, operational guidelines, and relevant regulations.
  • Conduct post-event analysis to capture learnings for future FIFA tournaments.

Your Profile

title: Especialista em Product Marketing Remote Work Full-time employee
description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Main responsibilities

Como Especialista em Product Marketing , você irá se juntar à nossa equipe de Marketing e terá uma atuação estratégica no desenvolvimento, crescimento e amadurecimento do marketing de produto para os produtos de nossas três verticais do portal OLX: Autos, Imóveis e Goods.

Sua missão será garantir que a proposta de valor dos nossos produtos seja bem compreendida por nossos clientes e potenciais clientes (B2B e B2C), e que estes, tirem o maior valor possível do seu uso. Você será responsável por acompanhar o processo completo do desenvolvimento do produto junto com os times de produto, engenharia e UX, desde o discovery, definição e desenvolvimento, até as estratégias de pré-lançamento e lançamento de produtos/features para impulsionar o awareness. Também irá acompanhar a adoção e o crescimento da receita das nossas verticais, tanto do ponto de vista B2C quanto B2B.

Por ser um papel no centro da operação, há muita interação com time de Produto, Pesquisa, Engenharia, Comercial e, claro, com os demais times de Marketing.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Atuar como liderança situacional em projetos de relevância dentro da equipe de Product Marketing dos portais OLX tanto para B2B e B2C;
  • Atuar em discussões estratégicas de Product Marketing relacionadas às verticais de atuação e garantir sua execução através do acompanhamento com todos os demais times cross envolvidos;
  • Cultivar relacionamento robusto e colaborações multifuncionais com equipes de produtos, vendas, sucesso do cliente, comercial e marketing;
  • Desenvolver profundo conhecimento em nossos principais segmentos (imóveis, autos e goods) para construir o conhecimento necessário para construir posicionamento direcionado e mensagens que impulsionem a aquisição, conversão e expansão de clientes B2B e B2C;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de produtos, participando desde o desenvolvimento, na construção da proposta de valor, no MVP até o Go To Market, e com o time comercial para monitorar o feedback do produto e montar planos para melhorar a satisfação dos clientes profissionais;
  • Contribuir para pesquisas e análises de mercado para identificar as necessidades dos clientes, tendências de mercado e cenário competitivo;
  • Compreender, documentar e manter as jornadas e personas dos compradores e vendedores e os perfis dos clientes ideais da OLX, ZAP e VR, incluindo onde eles obtêm informações e quem, o quê, quando e por que estão por trás das decisões de compra que tomam;
  • Construir estruturas de posicionamento, mensagens do produto de forma atraente e consistente com a narrativa geral da nossa empresa;
  • Fazer parceria com o marketing para desenvolvimento de estratégias de marketing interno e externo para impulsionar o conhecimento e adoção de produtos/features em canais de marketing;
  • Liderar o pré lançamento, lançamento e pós lançamento de features e produtos medindo o seu sucesso;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de Sales Academy para desenvolver conteúdos, programas, treinamentos, apresentações e ferramentas de sales enablement para comunicar a proposta de valor dos nossos produtos com objetivo de impulsionar a adoção e crescimento de receita B2B das verticais de Autos e Imóveis;
  • Colaborar com a liderança, equipes técnicas e de operações para monitorar o desempenho do produto e acompanhar os lançamentos de produtos e funcionalidadessob a sua responsabilidade continuamente garantindo seus sucessos e adoções no mercado;
  • Construir processos, sistemas, ferramentas/soluções robustos, otimização de fluxo de trabalho e automação para aumentar a eficiência operacional e a produtividade;
  • Analisar e resumir problemas e pontos problemáticos do produto para recomendar melhorias no produto.

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em Product Marketing em empresas de tecnologia ou varejo;
  • Expertise em Marketing de Produto e certificação do Pragmatic Institute, Product Marketing Alliance ou similar;
  • Capacidade de liderar e de se comunicar com outras áreas, como vendas, produto, engenharia, marketing e etc;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de posicionamento atraente e conteúdo de marketing para produtos B2B e B2C, incluindo a capacidade de traduzir recursos técnicos em benefícios claros e atraentes aos consumidores;
  • Habilidade destacada em contar histórias e capacidade de comunicar e traduzir questões técnicas em valores de negócios;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de solução de problemas, visão de negócios e capacidade de criar apresentações de nível gerencial sênior;
  • Perfil decisivo, pensamento crítico, mas flexível, com capacidade de atuar e se adaptar rapidamente em um ambiente dinâmico, em rápida mudança e em ritmo acelerado;
  • Habilidades de gerenciamento de tempo e grande atenção aos detalhes.

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

description:
Senior Growth Product Designer (Remote)

Mode Mobile.

The Role

We're seeking a bold, strategic UX Designer who blends creativity, analytical rigor, and a growth mindset. This is not a simple UI design role; it is for a thinker‑doer who wants to shape how millions of users engage, share, and monetize across our products.

You’ll design and optimize user experiences that drive engagement, retention, and revenue, starting with Mode's new social app, and expanding across Mode's broader portfolio. You’ll work at the intersection of design, product, data, and monetization, turning insights into elegant, high‑impact experiences that fuel growth loops and business outcomes.

We're looking for a self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity, sees patterns in data, and acts fast to test, learn, and scale what works.

Who You Are and What You’ll Do

  • Lead user research and experimentation to uncover friction points, unmet needs, and new opportunities for growth.
  • Design and iterate intuitive user flows, wireframes, and prototypes for mobile and web experiences that improve onboarding, engagement, and monetization.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and UA teams to design, ship, and measure high‑impact growth experiments (e.g., referral loops, sharing features, conversion paths).
  • Use qualitative and quantitative data to guide prioritization, validate design decisions, and inform the next iteration.
  • Contribute to scalable design systems and frameworks that enhance consistency and speed across products.
  • Champion a test‑and‑learn culture, balancing creativity with clear hypotheses, measurable results, and business impact.
  • Continuously propose new ideas, tools, or experiences that can unlock user delight and business performance.
  • Track the latest strategies and trends in app and web design to identify potential opportunities at Mode.

What You Bring to the Team

  • 4–6+ years in UX/UI design with a strong foundation in user research, experimentation, and growth‑driven design.
  • Proven success in B2C, consumer mobile or social products, ideally with experience in growth and scale, virality, or projects focusing on driving retention.
  • Fluent in data, comfortable running A/B tests, analyzing behavior funnels, and interpreting product metrics.
  • Strategic thinker with strong business instincts; understands how design decisions influence engagement, LTV, and revenue.
  • Proactive self‑starter who moves fast, collaborates well across teams, and takes ownership from idea to launch.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates bold ideas, measurable results, and clear storytelling around user and business impact.
  • Understanding or experimentation with AI to speed up and enhance design workflows.
  • Experience with use of AI for research and data interpretation.

Ideal Tools

  • Design: Figma (variables, auto‑layout, design system), Lottie, Framer (nice to have)
  • Research: Maze.co, usertesting.com, or similar + Mobbin
  • AI & Automation: GPT5 (for research), Sora.ai/nanobanana/Midjourney
  • Admin/Comms: Confluence/Jira, Slack, and Loom

Core Values

  • Accountable: Take ownership of responsibilities, maintain trustworthiness and self‑discipline.
  • Action‑driven: Identify priorities, agree on scope, execute timely, and drive impact.
  • Caring: Truly care about self, others, business, craft, and mission.
  • Curious: Focus on the 'why,' learn, expand knowledge, and improve continuously.
  • Thorough: Produce thoughtful, impactful, accurate, and complete work with meticulous detail.

Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to guide us.
  • Assume positive intent.
  • Agree to disagree & commit.
  • Set new precedents.
  • Accomplish more with less.
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards.
  • Speak up.
  • Be resourceful.
  • Follow the 80/20 rule.

Benefits

  • 100% remote‑first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Generous perks & benefits.
  • Participation in the company's equity plan.
  • Individual bonuses per the Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, results‑driven people.
  • Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
  • Recognition via Bonusly.
  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days.

Additional Information

We are a 100% remote‑first company and value your skill set highly. If you match this description, we look forward to discussing this opportunity.

Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy‑duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting‑edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions.

Responsibilities

  • In this position, the Service Technician will be responsible for carrying out service and maintenance tasks on turbochargers, working both at company facilities and at customer sites.
  • The role provides specialized technical support, executing activities in accordance with Accelleron workflows, quality standards, and safety guidelines — ensuring superior customer experience and operational excellence.
  • Service Delivery: Performs Service tasks like disassembly, cleaning, inspection, measurement and assembly of different types of turbochargers, in accordance with work instructions, through the identification of technical problems, carrying out remote and in‑person analyses at the Workshop and or in the field in various categories of vessels (ships, platforms, etc.) and thermoelectric plants. In the field it means by performing installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, updates, renovations and replacements, among others, meeting customer expectations and pre‑established internal procedures.
  • Customer Approach: Contributes to customer satisfaction by executing Service work according to customer order and expectation. Creates and maintains a good relationship with customers and understands their needs. Identifies new sales opportunities and communicates them internally. Execute the repair according to instructions from service coordination.
  • Materials & Supply: Coordinates, prepares and ensures that all materials, parts and equipment are available and at the appropriate quality for Service activities.
  • Documents & Reports: Prepares all documents and reports to be signed by the customer representative. Reports work done in a timely manner and follows up when needed. Perform maintenance inspections and reports on turbochargers. Clean up parts and take pictures and measurements as requested by maintenance tool and process.
  • Troubleshooting: Proactively identifies potential equipment failures and requests proactive corrective actions. Troubleshoots equipment failure and makes recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future.
  • Operational Excellence: Proactively identifies suggestions for product and quality improvement and communicates them further in the Accelleron organization. Provides recommendations to management to improve operations and customer service.
  • Health, Safety, Environmental, Quality and Integrity: Applies safety rules and safe practices, environmental responsibilities as well as quality process. Reports unsafe practices and incidents.

Background

Education and Experience

  • Technical training in Mechanics with an active CFT (Mechanical Technician Certificate).
  • Experience in maintenance and service of rotating machinery, engines (minimum 2 years), or preferable focus on working with turbochargers, large combustion engines, and/or mechanical technologies related to the maritime segment.
  • Preferable experience in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including the use of precision measuring instruments, hand tools, hydraulic and pneumatic tools, etc.
  • Preferably certified or experienced in lifting operations, overhead crane handling, and electric forklift, work at height, ensuring compliance with industrial safety standards.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, Planner etc.).
  • Intermediate English.
  • Availability for national and international travel to execute services and training.
  • Active driver's license.
  • Passport.

Core Competencies

  • Familiarity in working within regulations and rules, following management guidelines.
  • Service and solution‑oriented mindset, with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Customer and results orientation.
  • Responsibility, autonomy, and commitment to safety.
  • Effective communication and teamwork.
  • Proven capability to perform well under emergency work demand.
  • Proactivity and continuous improvement mindset.

Job Conditions

Descreva a Vaga

É responsável por visitar os postos conforme a rota definida, verificando a presença, postura, uniforme e equipamentos dos vigilantes, assegurando o cumprimento das normas operacionais estabelecidas. Também acompanha as escalas de trabalho, confirma a presença dos profissionais nos turnos e providencia coberturas em casos de faltas ou atrasos, realizando os devidos ajustes conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Entre suas atribuições está a aplicação de treinamentos práticos e rápidos no próprio local de trabalho (on-the-job), com foco na correção de falhas e reforço dos procedimentos de segurança. Além disso, é responsável por preencher checklists operacionais, relatar ocorrências, irregularidades e comunicar qualquer anormalidade à central ou à gerência.

Durante ocorrências, o supervisor presta apoio direto à equipe, atuando em casos como invasões, furtos ou acidentes, acionando as autoridades competentes quando necessário e registrando os fatos de forma clara e precisa.

Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão. Além disso, realiza inspeções surpresa para verificar a conduta dos vigilantes, o cumprimento de horários e a execução correta das rotinas nos postos.

description:
Join to apply for the Mechanical Technician Lead role at SBM Offshore

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. Shaping the future of energy and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with advancing our core: continuing to advance the decarbonisation of traditional energy production. While pioneering more: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

  • Mechanical Supervisor

Background

  • The Technician Lead must show strong safety behaviour acting as a safety culture disseminator.
  • They will ensure all procedures are followed and that O &M Contractor and local regulatory compliance are met in all aspects of work.
  • The Technician Lead is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • They are also responsible for ensuring that their supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The Technician Lead will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.
  • They act as a technical leader to all technicians using their seniority, technical experience and knowledge.
  • They can delegate work and responsibilities to technicians during the execution of their routines.
  • They act as a Technician when required by workload and/or requested by the Supervisor.

Authority

  • A Mechanical Technician Lead is authorized to maintain and repair vessel mechanical equipment and systems.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Mechanical Technicians, Subcontractors, Visitors and Vendor Representatives

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • Dismantle, Repair and Reassemble Mechanical Equipment.
  • Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
  • Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
  • Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
  • Identify, check and prepare components.
  • Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • Use of Condition Monitoring on Mechanical Equipment – Adjust instruments to meet operating specification, with minimum disruption and waste.
  • Monitor and record work history or log.
  • Diagnose faults in Mechanical Equipment – respond promptly, select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures, carry out visual, close and detailed inspections, use results to determine appropriate actions, and record accurate descriptions in documentation.
  • Monitor and maintain pollution control measures – identify unplanned discharges, halt where possible, report as required, use suitable PPE, dispose materials appropriately, enforce protection with colleagues.
  • Contribute to the health and safety of the working environment – keep work area clean, take positive action to stop hazards, raise alarms, alert colleagues, report incidents.
  • Emergency response – carry out emergency response role and demonstrate competence in drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies

  • Offshore – Demonstrate an Understanding of PandIds
  • Offshore – Routine Servicing of Systems and Equipment
  • Offshore – Rectifying Faults in Systems and Equipment
  • Offshore – Handover
  • Offshore – Emergency Response
  • Offshore – Diagnosis and Fault Finding
  • Offshore – Planning Work
  • Offshore – Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment
  • Offshore – Safety Management

Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience

  • Proven experience and/or qualification to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of B2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to the Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

GENERAL INFORMATION

It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

description:
Join to apply for the Lead Thumbnail Designer role at A Impact Media .

The position is remote and offers a competitive salary range of $42,000–$72,000 per year, depending on experience and team size managed.

Lead Thumbnail Designer | Remote

To Apply:

As the Lead Thumbnail Designer at Knwn Local, you will build and develop a team of 5–10+ thumbnail designers who create scroll‑stopping visuals that drive channel growth for America’s top real‑estate leaders. This is a player‑coach leadership role where you spend 60–80% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 20–40% hands‑on designing complex projects.

You will own design quality standards, team development, and creative operations across the agency, partnering closely with Pod Managers, the Creative Director, and leadership on strategic initiatives. Your success is measured by how well your team performs, grows, and delivers results that drive client success, not by the number of thumbnails you design.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development (50–70% of role)

  • Directly manage 5–8 thumbnail designers with weekly 1‑on‑1 skill development sessions.
  • Lead bi‑weekly team design reviews with constructive feedback.
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new hires.
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria.
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework.
  • Handle hiring (write JDs, screen portfolios, interview, make offers).
  • Build 2–5+ year relationships with designers through proactive retention and engagement strategies.
  • Conduct skip‑level meetings with junior designers to assess team health and identify early warning signs.

Creative Excellence & Standards (20–30% of role)

  • Design 15–30 high‑impact thumbnails per month for VIP clients and complex projects.
  • Own and evolve agency‑wide creative quality standards, brand guidelines, and style guides.
  • Establish QA processes that maintain 90%+ first‑approval rate.
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and performance analysis across the client portfolio.
  • Serve as final creative approval for all thumbnails before client delivery.
  • Drive creative innovation through monthly experimentation initiatives and "Good Flops".
  • Create and maintain the design team’s template library and asset management systems.

Strategic Collaboration & Systems (10–20% of role)

  • Partner with Pod Managers on client strategy and creative direction for key accounts.
  • Present creative strategy and performance insights in monthly client strategy calls.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership on agency‑wide creative vision and initiatives.
  • Build scalable workflows, capacity planning, and resource allocation systems.
  • Create performance dashboards tracking team metrics (CTR, approval rates, turnaround times).
  • Document best practices, SOPs, and knowledge base for the design function.
  • Contribute to quarterly planning, annual strategy summits, and company OKRs.

Requirements

Leadership & Design Experience

  • 6+ years of professional design experience with 2+ years managing creative teams.
  • Proven track record leading, developing, and scaling design teams of 5+ people.
  • Minimum 3+ years creating high‑performing YouTube thumbnails with proven CTR results.
  • Experience hiring designers, conducting performance reviews, and managing accountability.
  • Portfolio showcasing thumbnails that contributed to channel growth (include CTR data).
  • Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, firing, conflict resolution).

Technical & Strategic Skills

  • Expert‑level proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma (portfolio required).
  • Deep understanding of YouTube algorithms, CTR optimization, and viewer psychology.
  • Data‑driven approach with ability to interpret analytics and translate into design strategy.
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies, performance analysis, and optimization.
  • Strong presentation skills for client‑facing strategy calls and executive meetings.
  • Understanding of creative team economics (capacity planning, resourcing, budgeting).

Communication & Cultural Leadership

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality.
  • Extreme Ownership – takes full accountability for team results; never blames or makes excuses.
  • Beyond Excellence – sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to exceed them.
  • Proactive Curiosity – anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of needs.
  • Mission Focus – obsesses about client success and team development over personal recognition.

# Results

Team Performance

  • Design team maintains 90%+ first‑approval rate across all designers.
  • Designer retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression.
  • New designers productive at 80% capacity within 30–60 days.
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter‑over‑quarter.
  • Team operates at 80–90% capacity utilization – productive output without burnout.

Quality & Impact

  • Zero client escalations due to design quality issues or missed deadlines.
  • Agency‑wide thumbnail CTR averages 5–10% (significantly above platform benchmarks).
  • 95%+ on‑time delivery rate across the entire team’s project portfolio.
  • Design workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency‑wide.
  • Team generates innovative thumbnail strategies that drive agency‑wide adoption.

Strategic Leadership

  • Design function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership.
  • Contribute to client strategy with design insights that drive performance.
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for design quality and communication.
  • At least 1–2 designers promoted or advancement‑ready annually due to your mentorship.
  • Leadership views design as a strategic differentiator, not just an execution function.

Compensation & Growth

Salary & Benefits

  • Starting Range: $42,000 – $72,000 USD/year depending on experience and team size managed.
  • Fully Remote.
  • Flexible Time Off policy & Company‑Wide Holiday Breaks.
  • Professional development budget for courses, plugins, and creative tools.
  • Potential Health Insurance Reimbursement (after 60–90 day trial period).
  • Potential to earn Monthly wellness allowance.
  • Potential to earn Home office stipend for equipment and software.
  • Leadership development program.
  • Access to industry‑leading tools, plugins, and AI‑assisted editing software.
  • Clear career progression with transparent promotion criteria.

Performance Metrics You'll Own

  • Team Performance: Design Quality Score, First‑Approval Rate (90%+), CTR performance.
  • Team Development: Skill progression, promotion readiness, retention rate (85%+).
  • Operational Excellence: Capacity utilization (80–90%), on‑time delivery (95%+).
  • Strategic Impact: Innovation initiatives, process improvements, client satisfaction (>4.5/5).

Location

100% Remote.

Who We Are

Knwn Local helps America’s top real‑estate leaders (ranked by the Wall Street Journal Real Trends) attract more clients and grow their brands through strategic YouTube presence. Our clients manage $30M–$300M+ real‑estate teams and brokerages. We’re scaling from 55+ to 200+ channels with the mission of helping agents dominate their local markets through long‑form video content that builds trust and authority.

Core Values

Extreme Ownership, Beyond Excellence, Proactive Curiosity, Mission Focus.

What You’ll Need to Be Comfortable With

  • Remote team leadership (building culture and managing performance without in‑person oversight).
  • Rigorous hiring process including portfolio review, leadership case study, design test, and interviews.
  • 90‑day paid trial period with clear success metrics and transparent evaluation.
  • Player‑coach expectations (10–30% IC work even as you grow the team).

A SEW é a plataforma em nuvem nº 1 para Energia e Água , oferecendo soluções SaaS (Software como Serviço) voltadas para Engajamento Digital de Clientes , Engajamento de Equipes de Campo e Inteligência Artificial/Aprendizado de Máquina aplicadas ao setor de energia e utilidades.

Nosso objetivo é capacitar as empresas de energia e saneamento a aprimorar o atendimento ao cliente, otimizar a eficiência operacional e maximizar o retorno sobre investimentos por meio dos aplicativos da plataforma SEW, que utilizam tecnologias de mobilidade, IA, aprendizado de máquina e computação em nuvem .

Procurando o emprego dos sonhos? Na SEW, buscamos ajudar nossos colaboradores a encontrar propósito e paixão no que fazem. Junte-se a nós para transformar a forma como o mundo utiliza energia e água e faça parte de uma equipe inovadora e talentosa !

Descrição da Posição

Buscamos um(a) profissional proativo(a) e organizado(a) para apoiar nossas operações financeiras e administrativas no Brasil .

Essa função é responsável por coordenar as atividades diárias do escritório e auxiliar nos processos financeiros, em colaboração com nosso escritório de contabilidade terceirizado e a equipe financeira da América Latina (LATAM Finance) .

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponto de contato com o provedor terceirizado de contabilidade e tributos, garantindo a entrega pontual de relatórios e o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais.
  • Apoiar as operações administrativas diárias (coordenação de fornecedores, logística, documentação e materiais de escritório).
  • Auxiliar na preparação de relatórios internos e na organização das informações para o fechamento financeiro mensal.
  • Coordenar a comunicação com consultores externos e autoridades locais, quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para a implementação de procedimentos financeiros internos e manter a documentação alinhada às políticas regionais.

Requisitos de Formação e Experiência

  • Formação: Ensino superior em Contabilidade, Finanças ou áreas correlatas .
  • Experiência: Atuação prévia em suporte financeiro.
  • Idiomas: Proficiência em inglês (mandatório). Espanhol será um diferencial.
  • Conhecimentos: Noções de processos contábeis e fiscais brasileiros , com experiência de trabalho junto a prestadores de serviços externos.
  • Competências: Forte capacidade de organização , atenção aos detalhes e autonomia para trabalhar de forma independente.

Por que trabalhar na SEW?

  • Faça parte de uma organização guiada por propósito , criando soluções de alto impacto para os setores de energia e água.
  • Colabore com uma equipe talentosa e inovadora em projetos de ponta.
  • Tenha oportunidades reais de crescimento profissional e desenvolvimento de habilidades.
  • Atue em uma cultura que valoriza a diversidade, a criatividade e a colaboração .

Diversidade e Inclusão

A SEW é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades . Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para as vagas independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, gravidez, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência, informações genéticas, condição de veterano protegido ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei.

Nosso pessoal está no centro do que fazemos na Baker Hughes. Sabemos que somos melhores quando todas as nossas pessoas são desenvolvidas, engajadas e capazes de trazer todo o seu eu autêntico para o trabalho. Investimos na saúde e no bem-estar de nossa força de trabalho, treinamos e recompensamos talentos e desenvolvemos líderes em todos os níveis para trazer o melhor uns dos outros.

Trabalhando para você

Nossas invenções revolucionaram a energia por mais de um século. Mas para seguir em frente amanhã, sabemos que temos que ultrapassar os limites hoje. Priorizamos recompensar aqueles que adotam a mudança com um pacote que reflete o quanto valorizamos sua contribuição. Junte-se a nós e você pode esperar:

  • Rede de segurança de seguros de vida e programas de invalidez

  • Benefícios adicionais eleitos ou voluntários

Sobre nós

Com operações em mais de 120 países, oferecemos melhores soluções para nossos clientes e oportunidades mais ricas para nosso pessoal. Como um parceiro líder do setor de energia, estamos comprometidos em alcançar emissões líquidas de carbono zero até 2050 e estamos sempre procurando as pessoas certas para nos ajudar a chegar lá. Pessoas tão apaixonadas quanto nós por tornar a energia mais segura, limpa e eficiente.

Junte-se a nós

Você está procurando uma oportunidade de fazer uma diferença real em uma empresa com alcance global e serviços e clientes interessantes? Junte-se a nós e cresça com uma equipe de pessoas que irão energizar e inspirar você!

About Us

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES

ontem, hoje e sempre Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE

não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS

pensamos sempre grande A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao paciente internado no setor, realizando procedimentos diversos, tais como: higiene ocular, oral, íntima e corporal, aferição de peso, medições de diurese, administração de medicamentos, mudança de decúbito, aspiração de vias aéreas superiores, traqueostomia e tubo orofaríngeo, troca de curativos, administração de contraste oral e venoso, realização das fichas de transferência interna entre setores, aferição de sinais vitais, acompanhamento de pacientes durante transporte, entre outros, conforme definido nos POPs (Procedimento Operacional Padrão) definidos pela Unidade, visando resolver todas as intercorrências necessárias;

Nós somos a Karoon Energy Brasil, seja muito bem-vindo(a)!

A Karoon Energy é uma empresa internacional de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás natural, com projetos no Brasil, no Golfo do México e na Austrália, com ações listadas na bolsa de valores da Austrália.

A companhia detém e opera 100% do Campo de Baúna , localizado ao sul da Bacia de Santos, que compreende os reservatórios de Baúna, Piracaba e Patola. A companhia também detém os campos de Neon e Goiá , e o bloco S-M-1537, todos ao sul da Bacia de Santos .

No Golfo da América , a companhia tem uma participação não-operacional de 30% nos campos de petróleo e gás Who Dat e Dome Patrol, 16% no campo Abilene, assim como variadas participações em infraestrutura na área de exploração na costa da Louisiana (EUA).

Vem fazer parte do Time IDG

Somos uma organização social privada sem fins lucrativos, especializada em gerir centros culturais públicos de grande importância para o país e programas ambientais. Atualmente, também prestamos consultorias para a concepção, modelagem, formatação e gestão de projetos, desenvolvendo o escopo, fazendo a captação de recursos, o enquadramento nas leis de incentivo e gerindo sua implementação.

O Paço do Frevo , localizado no coração do Recife, é mais do que um museu; é um guardião do patrimônio mundial da humanidade, celebrando a riqueza e a diversidade de nossa cultura.

O Museu do Amanhã , uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu das Favelas em São Paulo é um espaço de resiliência e criatividade das comunidades, revelando a potência e o brilho das favelas através de suas histórias e expressões culturais únicas.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CULTSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual, Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um. Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus. Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Sitting within the Ticketing Department, Ticketing aims to deliver the most engaging, innovative, and accessible Women’s World Cup experience for all athletes, fans, partners, and the community.

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing, the Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will help serve Ticketing sales, operations and efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil™ 2027 that for the first time ever, will be hosted in South America. Work in close consultation and collaboration with FIFA Zurich.

The Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive ticket sales strategies to ensure optimal attendance and revenue generation for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 in Brazil. The role requires a strong understanding of the Brazilian sports market, exceptional stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to drive innovative ticketing initiatives not only across all 8 host cities but in the wider region.

Ensuring an exceptional and consistent approach in the planning phase as well as throughout the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and execute ticket sales strategies to maximize revenue and stadium occupancy across all venues.
  • Design and implement Ticket Sales Strategy for the project, including but not limited to ticket products, sales phases, and pricing strategies tailored to different market segments.
  • Conduct market analysis to optimise sales projections and adapt pricing dynamically.
  • Collaborate with the ticketing project management as well as the CRM team to ensure strategies and processes are aligned.
  • Collaborate with the FIFA Hospitality team and the Official Hospitality Provider to ensure Hospitality’s product positioning and pricing is integrated into the overall ticketing strategy and objectives.
  • Engage with local communities, fan groups, and host city stakeholders to drive awareness and interest in the tournament.
  • Collaborate with marketing and communications teams to build and ensure the alignment of ticketing and hospitality promotions with overall event campaigns and timelines.
  • Build and manage relationships with domestic stakeholders incl., venue operators, host cities and key stakeholders to optimize ticketing and hospitality opportunities.
  • Monitor ticket sales performance, analyze data, and provide regular reports with insights and recommendations for improvement, with a particular focus on strategies to increase sales, attendance, and overall revenue.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA ticketing standards, operational guidelines, and relevant regulations.
  • Conduct post-event analysis to capture learnings for future FIFA tournaments.

Your profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Sport Management, Marketing, Economics or relevant area.

Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience in: Ticket sales for major sports events; including but not limited to the definition of the strategies to increase sales, attendance and revenues – preferably with experience in the Brazilian market.
  • Planning and delivery of a similar project

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of Brazilian market trends and ticketing legislation
  • Ability to design and execute ticketing strategies that maximize revenue and stadium occupancy.
  • Understanding dynamic pricing, market segmentation, and sales optimization in a large scale event context.
  • Strong skills in developing ticketing products, packages, and pricing models that drive demand.
  • Ability to translate data insights into actionable strategies Diplomatic , able to create and nurture stakeholder relationships.
  • Courteous with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, organised, resilient.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, and as part of a team.
  • Good numerical and time management skills.
  • Ability to prioritise, and be assertive where necessary.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Flexible working hours, readiness for stand-by duty.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

$1,500 ‑ $2,500 (USD) per month.

Your Role

You are a detail‑oriented, results‑driven professional with a passion for maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency in operational processes and procedures. Everything goes through QA, so you will be directly responsible for ensuring the success of our campaign launches which connects millions of consumers to our clients monthly! You will also be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our operations to ensure they meet and exceed industry standards and organizational objectives. Your unwavering attention to detail and thorough analysis skills will be invaluable in detecting and identifying potential problems within our daily operations. Additionally, you have a proven track record in quality management, process improvement, and possess industry‑specific knowledge. Your ability to collaborate and work cross‑functionally, leveraging your industry‑specific expertise, will enable you to implement effective solutions, making a significant impact on our company's operational excellence.

  • Reconciling reporting between internal tracking platforms and external client platforms to ensure proper tracking.

  • Ensuring QA is successfully implemented with any new process that is rolled out.
  • Quickly becoming a subject matter expert for all QA related processes.

What You Need To Succeed

  • 2-3 years in operations or quality assurance and expertise in digital media advertising.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Understanding of Postback URL tracking and other performance marketing methods of tracking.
  • Experience with Tune & Yieldspark or similar tracking tools.
  • Experience with Asana or other project management tools.
  • Experience with Looker or similar BI tools like Tableau or PowerBI.
  • Proven abilities to analyze performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Proven problem solving abilities and #BetterEveryDay mindset.
  • Proactive mindset, searching for opportunities rather than just completing tasks.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

title: Volunteer System Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament.

This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organisational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

O Museu do Amanhã , uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu das Favelas em São Paulo é um espaço de resiliência e criatividade das comunidades, revelando a potência e o brilho das favelas através de suas histórias e expressões culturais únicas.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CultSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual,Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um.Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus.Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

title: Assist Driller
description:
Overview

  • Assist the Driller in operating drilling and mud circulating equipment as instructed in the well program and in accordance to Company policies and procedures.
  • Actively promote Transocean Shared Values.

Resumo do Perfil do Cargo

  • Assist the Driller in operating drilling and mud circulating equipment as instructed in the well program and in accordance to Company policies and procedures.
  • Actively promote Transocean Shared Values.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Reporting

Reports to: Driller

Supervision

Derrickhand, Pumphand, and Floorhand, Rover

Pre-requisite/Qualification

  • High School Diploma (U.S.)/ Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable)
  • Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S.
  • Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred
  • Valid medical examination and vaccination certificates
  • Knowledge of all technical calculations required for the safe operation within the drilling operations.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid well control certificate per the standard defined on the training matrix.

General Requirements

  • Promotes a Safe and Respectful Work Environment: Proactively promotes and Maintains a healthy respect for open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well-being of all personnel, at all times. Invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement of those qualified, to fulfill their career objectives. Respects the dignity of all personnel and recognizes their merit.
  • Attend and participate in all required Safety and Operational meetings.
  • Participate fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements.
  • Complete company training requirements for the Assistant Driller job level as per the training matrix, including in local/regulatory requirements.
  • If applicable, the duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position must be observed.
  • Full participation in emergency drills and respond to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.
  • Norway Specific: Responsible to follow up on the working environment within the rig department.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • This is inclusive of:
    • Understanding and perform the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre-job meeting.
    • Understanding the hazards associated with the task.
    • Understanding and effectively implementing the control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
    • Execute all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
    • Recognize at risk behavior or conditions during tasks and call ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure, or when the job does not go as planned.
    • Participate in After Action Reviews to feedback lessons learned from performing the task.

HSE Requirements

  • Demonstrate commitment and leadership in the protection of personnel, the environment, and assets.
  • Coach personnel in the understanding of applicable Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Ensure work is executed in accordance with Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Call a Time Out when a real or perceived at risk behavior or unsafe condition is observed.
  • Coach personnel to use WorkSight ENGAGE during the execution of planned work.
  • Use WorkSight COACH during the execution of planned work and daily operations to reinforce Company requirements.
  • Report all incidents, potential hazards, or abnormal situations. Ensure reported situations are acknowledged properly.
  • Ensure the Control of Work process is complied with when planning and managing the execution of work.
  • Ensure major accident barriers / controls are maintained.
  • Ensure safe and organized work areas are maintained.
  • Understand your role in an emergency, as designated in the Emergency Response Plan and Station Bill.
  • Lead or participate in all emergency drills and exercises, as required.
  • Ensure change is properly controlled and managed.

    • Duties

    The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements. When considering assignment of duties for the Assistant Driller, the Supervisor and the Assistant Driller will apply the rules of task planning (CAKES) to determine if the assigned role is appropriate. This means confirming that the individuals involved have the knowledge, skills, and experience to carry out the task, and the task plan complies with policy before they are authorized to proceed.

    Operations/Maintenance

    GENERAL DUTIES

    • Perform the drilling department’s daily checklists, i.e. QHSE checks, Derrick inspection, choke and mud manifold line ups, etc.
    • Maintain accurate BHA record of tubular and tool dimensions (i.e. internal and external diameter, fish neck, handling profiles and serial numbers etc.).
    • Calculate ton-miles on drilling line; maintain an accurate logbook and advise the Driller on the need to slip and cut.
    • Maintain an organized drilling equipment store and tubular and subs inventory.
    • Maintain proper communication with the Driller, Toolpusher, and other department heads.
    • Read and interpret various gauges and meters relating to the drilling operations; assist the Driller in maintaining records and logs.
    • Actively participate in pre-tour meeting with the drilling crew for all drilling operations.
    • Assist and relieve the Driller at the Driller’s console during drilling operations.
    • Assist with the preparation of equipment for impending drilling operations.
    • Organize and supervise the drilling crews for all operations.
    • Assist the Driller during an emergency or well control situation; assist in the well killing operations.
    • Assist in supervision of Preventive Maintenance carried out on drilling equipment.
    • Assist in supervision of repairs on drilling and associated equipment.
    • Assist in running and cementing casing strings, running and retrieving BOPs and risers, and other operations as directed by the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Monitor mud systems and supervise solids control equipment and mud mixing operation.
    • Assist in the planning, organization and execution of rig move operations.
    • Operate drilling and associated equipment as directed by the Driller, i.e. Top Drive System, mud pumps, BOP and Diverter controls, etc.
    • Know the clients’ rules and Company procedures for well control and blowout prevention.
    • Incorporate the THINK process into all tasks, whether working alone or as part of a team.
    • Participate daily in START process.
    • Ensure subordinate personnel are properly trained in the START process.
    • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) whenever an unplanned hazard or a change in the expected results is observed.
    • Ensure all relevant safety procedures and practices are adhered to during drilling operations, in accordance to the Company QHSE manual.
    • Report any incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Actively participate in weekly safety meetings and pre-tour meetings as required, FOCUS Improvement Process, and all other Company safety management systems.
    • Assist in conducting drilling operations safety drills as and when required.
    • Demonstrate commitment to the Company’s safety policies through leadership and guidance.
    • Ensure that a high standard of hygiene and housekeeping is maintained onboard the rig.
    • Meet the training requirements according to the applicable training matrix.
    • Participate in the annual performance appraisal process.
    • Mentor, coach, develop and train crew members to ensure that they are competent to work at their next job level.
    • Provide leadership and motivation to rig personnel; Apply continuous improvement process.
    • Assist in training to ensure that all personnel are competent to perform their allocated jobs.
    • Promote and maintain a good working relationship with other departments, third-party personnel and Customer Representatives.
    • Assist the Driller with the operation during the running and retrieving of marine risers, BOP and auxiliary equipment.

    Personnel

    • Promote and maintain good working relationships with other departments, third-party personnel and Customer representatives.
    • Ensure all Drilling personnel meet the training requirements as per their applicable training matrix.
    • Mentor, coach, develop and train crew members to ensure they are competent to work at their next job level.
    • Provide leadership and motivation to the drilling crews. Apply continuous improvement process.
    • Assist in training to ensure that all personnel are competent to perform their allocated jobs.
    • Participate fully in the annual performance appraisal process.
    • Apply appropriate accountability regarding recognition; recommend promotion or disciplinary action up to and including discharge.

    Full-time

title: Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer
description:
Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer

The Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer is responsible for the administration, optimization, and continuous improvement of security technologies, while also serving as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex security incidents. This role bridges advanced incident response with hands‑on engineering of cybersecurity tools, ensuring seamless integration, effective threat detection, and rapid response capabilities. Acting as an extension of external Tier 1 and Tier 2 security operations, the engineer plays a critical role in enhancing the organization’s overall security posture through proactive monitoring, tool fine‑tuning, and strategic incident handling.

Security Tools Administration

  • Administer and optimize security tools, including SIEM, EDR/XDR (Microsoft Defender), firewalls, vulnerability management, email and identity security solutions.
  • Ensure seamless integration of security tools with IT and cloud environments for continuous monitoring and threat detection.
  • Maintain security policies, configurations, and automation rules to improve operational efficiency and reduce false positives.
  • Manage log sources, data ingestion pipelines, and correlation rules within SIEM to enhance security visibility.

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Act as a Tier 3 escalation point for security incidents requiring advanced investigation and resolution.
  • Conduct deep‑dive forensic analysis and threat‑hunting activities to detect and mitigate sophisticated threats.
  • Support the SOC team and external Tier 1 & Tier 2 analysts by providing expertise on complex security incidents.
  • Enhance and refine incident response playbooks, ensuring effective collaboration across all security layers.
  • Align incident response efforts with cybersecurity frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, and ISO 27001.

Threat Intelligence & Vulnerability Management

  • Analyze threat intelligence feeds and proactively adjust defenses based on evolving attack techniques.
  • Coordinate vulnerability assessments, collaborate with IT teams, and track remediation efforts to mitigate risks.
  • Perform proactive threat‑hunting activities to identify potential security gaps before they are exploited.
  • Ensure compliance with patch management policies and security best practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in security tools administration, incident response, or security operations.
  • Experience in listed companies, large‑scale enterprises, or multi‑geographical organizations is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Security solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewalls, and security automation tools.
  • Proficiency in threat intelligence, forensic analysis, and malware analysis.
  • Strong understanding of network security, log analysis, and cloud security.
  • Experience with vulnerability management solutions.
  • CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst, or equivalent.
  • Availability to travel internationally.

Soft Skills

  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with IT, cloud, and development teams, as well as external security partners.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Resilient.
  • Willingness to stay current with evolving cybersecurity threats and technologies.
  • Ability to manage multiple security incidents and projects simultaneously.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Engajar, influenciar, negociar e trabalhar em conjunto com sua equipe e com as lideranças das unidades construindo a Cultura de Segurança de pessoas e processos na UHH, sendo exemplo no cumprimento dos requisitos aplicáveis para todos na unidade de atuação.
  • Cumprir com a gestão da rotina da unidade, tais como: NR 32, CIPA, PAE, Brigada de Incêndio, Simulados de Emergência, AVCB, acidentes de trabalho, checklists realizados, treinamentos, PGR – NR 01, PRGS/ PGRSS, etc, acompanhando e reportando os processos de auditoria interna e externa, bem como as visitas e fiscalizações de autoridades públicas.

  • Realizar a gestão e controle dos sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndio para assegurar que estejam em plenas condições de funcionamento, corretamente instalados e com as análises periódicas dentro da validade e de acordo com o projeto de combate a incêndio da unidade, bem como a execução de todos processos e fluxos de incêndio.
  • Avaliar previamente os requisitos para execução de atividades perigosas (trabalho em altura, eletricidade, espaços confinados, energias perigosas, trabalho a quente, escavação, elevação e suspensão de cargas, etc), elaborando a APR (Analise Preliminar de Risco) e a PT (Permissão do Trabalho) antes do início das atividades e que elas sejam realizadas de acordo com a legislação vigente, com as diretrizes definidas pela UHG e com requisitos de acreditação / certificação e assessment relacionados a área.
  • Participar ativamente de todas as investigações de incidentes e acidentes, com o objetivo de identificar as causas raízes, propor planos de ação para evitar a recorrência, bem como compartilhar os aprendizados, reportando mensalmente os dados de acidentes do trabalho, doenças ocupacionais e agentes insalubres das unidades sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Dar suporte para implementação de todos os projetos de inovação para a melhoria dos processos de Segurança do Trabalho por meio de visitas técnicas, desenvolvimento de controle, levantamento de dados e outras atuações de forma a alavancar resultados da Segurança e das áreas parceiras, tais como meio ambiente, saúde e qualidade de vida nas suas unidades.
  • Realizar a gestão de documentação e atividades perigosas das subcontratadas ao que tange diretrizes de Segurança do Trabalho, controlando a documentação e inspecionando as atividades, a fim de buscar a padronização nos documentos e dos processos.
